image_description: A medium shot of an orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus) perched on a metal structure with thick white ropes. The ape has characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and is gripping the ropes with its hands. The background consists of out-of-focus green foliage, suggesting an outdoor enclosure or natural habitat.
